frozen_candidate_root_contribution: طين (ṭīn) is a single frozen nominal naming a concrete substance: moist, cohesive, moldable earthen matter (clay) functioning as the raw, pre-form source-material out of which shaped things are produced — a human/bashar, a bird-shape, fired bricks, or hardened projectile stones. It is a substance/source noun, never the finished artifact, and it is agent-, purpose-, and valence-neutral.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: طين (ṭīn) is a single frozen nominal naming a concrete substance: moist, cohesive, moldable earthen matter (clay) functioning as the raw, pre-form source-material out of which shaped things are produced — a human/bashar, a bird-shape, fired bricks, or hardened projectile stones. It is a substance/source noun, never the finished artifact, and it is agent-, purpose-, and valence-neutral.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the 12 occurrences is the same noun ṭīn (only case/definiteness vary; no verb, participle, plural, or derived nominal exists). Across all of them the word points to the identical stuff: wet, workable, cohesive earth used as the material something is made FROM. What differs is supplied by the surrounding verbs and nouns (خلق 'create/shape', أوقد 'kindle/fire', أرسل 'send'; بشر, هيئة الطير, حجارة, صرح), not by ṭīn. The frequent 'man is made of clay' sense is therefore a property of the collocation khalaqa…min, not of the word: strip that collocation (Pharaoh firing clay into bricks, 28:38; stones of clay, 51:33) and ṭīn is bare industrial/earthen material. Because the root surfaces as only one lexeme with no derivational field, the 'unity' achieved is essentially the identity of a concrete mass noun, and its distinctiveness from other earth-creation terms cannot be tested here; hence a stable but modest result rather than a strong root-generalization.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT fire and NOT the 'noble/higher' element — ṭīn is explicitly set against نار (7:12, 38:76), the earthy non-fire pole. NOT life/animacy — it is the inert input; life is conferred by نفخ (3:49, 5:110), not by ṭīn. NOT the finished form/artifact — distinct from the ṣarḥ (28:38), the bird-hayʾah (3:49/5:110), the ḥijārah (51:33), the human (6:2); it is always the pre-form material. NOT inherently 'creation-substance' — 28:38 and 51:33 use ṭīn outside any creation frame. NOT inherently sticky, hard, or soft-only — stickiness (لازب, 37:11) and hardness (حجارة, 51:33) are added/resultant qualifiers, and firing (28:38) plus stone-formation show hardenable states. NOT a fixed moral valence — Iblis's disdain (nār > ṭīn) is the speaker's rhetoric, not lexicalized. NOT the bird-root ط ي ر (طير co-occurs in 3:49/5:110 but is a different root).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 28:38 (Pharaoh: «فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا») together with 51:33 («حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ») strip away every contextual halo — no creation, no divine agency, no life, no punishment-by-creation — leaving ṭīn as ordinary industrial/earthen material fired into bricks and constituting hard stones. These two tokens single-handedly disprove any 'creation/origin substance' nucleus: the origin-of-life reading in the other tokens comes from the verb خَلَقَ + مِن, not from ṭīn. They do not resist the bare-substance account; they confirm and broaden it while defeating the richer creation reading.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: 'ṭīn's contribution is the substance of (human) origination/creation.' Attractive because 8/12 are human-creation contexts and 10/12 carry khalaqa…min. Rejected as root-level: 28:38 (bricks) and 51:33 (stones) sit wholly outside any creation frame, and 3:49/5:110 are a human agent molding a non-human bird-form; the origination sense is thus a dominant collocation, not the nucleus. A second competitor — 'generic earth/soil/matter' — is rejected as too broad by لازب (37:11, loose soil is not 'sticky') and by firing clay into brick (28:38), which push the referent toward specifically cohesive, moldable, fireable clay. The narrowest sustained account is therefore the bare moldable-earthen-substance nucleus.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: 'ṭīn's contribution is the substance of (human) origination/creation.' Attractive because 8/12 are human-creation contexts and 10/12 carry khalaqa…min. Rejected as root-level: 28:38 (bricks) and 51:33 (stones) sit wholly outside any creation frame, and 3:49/5:110 are a human agent molding a non-human bird-form; the origination sense is thus a dominant collocation, not the nucleus. A second competitor — 'generic earth/soil/matter' — is rejected as too broad by لازب (37:11, loose soil is not 'sticky') and by firing clay into brick (28:38), which push the referent toward specifically cohesive, moldable, fireable clay. The narrowest sustained account is therefore the bare moldable-earthen-substance nucleus.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts converge that the referent is a single, adversarially-clean concrete substance across 12/12, with the human-creation sense carried by collocation rather than by the word. Lenses A and B propose STRONG/GENERAL; the adversary C proposes MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, and its structural objection is decisive under the contract's over-grading guard: (i) the root is monoform — 12 tokens, one lexeme, form N throughout, zero derivational spread — so there is no productive root-verbal semantics to stress-test and the claimed 'root contribution' is near-indistinguishable from a lexeme's referent; (ii) the only semantically contentful nucleus (origination) is refuted by 28:38 and 51:33; (iii) even Lens B concedes that distinctiveness from sibling earth-terms (turāb, ṣalṣāl, ḥamaʾ masnūn) is UNRESOLVED because those neighbours are absent from this packet, so the 'distinctive' component of the STRONG bar is not met. No occurrence resists the bare-substance account (that reading is clean), but STRONG's requirement of broad, distinctive, adversarially-clean evidence is not satisfied by a single frozen nominal with untested distinctiveness. Hence MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE, scoped to the lexicalized nominal ṭīn.

clusters.classification_rationale: Eight tokens governed by مِن (or, in 17:61, accusative ṭīnan as ḥāl/tamyīz 'created [as] clay' — the one syntactically deviant token whose referent is nonetheless unchanged). 37:11 attributively qualifies ṭīn as لازب (sticky/cohesive), showing stickiness is an added property of the same substance. 7:12 and 38:76 set ṭīn against نار, fixing it as the earthy non-fire pole.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: «خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ» (6:2); «خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ» (38:71); «خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ» (37:11); «خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ» (7:12, 38:76); accusative «لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا» (17:61) leaves the referent unchanged.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ṭīn as the definite clay a human agent (Jesus, by divine leave) molds into a non-human bird-shape (كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ), before نفخ confers life.
clusters.classification_rationale: Two definite-genitive tokens with the same collocation خلق…من (ٱل)طين but a non-human product and a human maker, showing the substance is ordinary moldable clay, not a human-specific creation-stuff. Confirms ṭīn is the inert pre-form input (life added by فأنفخ).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: «أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ» (3:49); «تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ» (5:110).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ṭīn as ordinary earthen material outside any creation frame — fired into brick to raise a tower (28:38) and constituting hard projectile stones (51:33). Consistent with the bare-substance nucleus; adversarial against the creation-substance competitor.
clusters.classification_rationale: Two tokens with no خَلَقَ collocation: 28:38 uses أوقد…على الطين (mundane human technology by a disbeliever), 51:33 makes ṭīn the stuff of حجارة. They demonstrate the substance is agent/purpose-neutral and hardenable, and they are the decisive counterevidence to any 'creation/origin' nucleus. They do not resist the bare-substance reading — they broaden it.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: «فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا» (28:38); «لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ» (51:33).

adversarial_verification.notes: The bare moldable-earthen-substance nucleus holds cleanly across all 12 tokens with zero failing occurrences, and within-packet distinctiveness is established (ṭīn ≠ نار in 7:12/38:76; ṭīn = raw source vs the سلالة/product in 23:12). But a PASSED verdict is withheld: distinctiveness from the sibling earth-creation terms turāb/ṣalṣāl/ḥamaʾ masnūn cannot be tested because they are absent from this packet, and the root is monoform (no derivational family to stress-test), so distinctiveness_ok cannot be affirmed. Marked NOT_RUN in the strong sense: core holds, full adversarial distinctiveness testing is not possible here.

layer_attribution.lexical_class: A single lexicalized concrete mass/substance noun ṭīn: moist, cohesive, moldable earthen matter serving as pre-form source-material; sub-states (sticky لازب, fired brick, hardened stone) are qualifiers/results of one substance, not distinct lexemes.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The frequent 'substance man is created from' reading, the divine-permission bird-modeling, Pharaoh's brick-firing, and the punishment-stones are all narrative/contextual applications supplied by governing verbs (خلق, أوقد, أرسل) and adjacent nouns — they must NOT be absorbed into the root claim, which is only the bare substance.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Analysts A/B (STRONG) and adversary C (MODERATE) are reconciled by accepting the shared clean substance nucleus while adopting C's structural caps (monoformity + collocational creation sense + untested cross-term distinctiveness); no per-occurrence disposition needed reversal since all 12 are CONSISTENT with the substance nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence resists the bare-substance nucleus. What remains unresolved is not resistance but distinctiveness: whether ṭīn is semantically distinct from other Quranic earth-creation terms (turāb/ṣalṣāl/ḥamaʾ masnūn) cannot be settled from this packet, which is why strength is held at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: Pharaoh fires al-ṭīn into brick to build a ṣarḥ — no creation, no divine agency, no life. Strips every contextual halo and shows the 'creation-substance' sense is collocational (khalaqa…min), not root-borne; the bare substance is ordinary earthen/industrial material.

evidence_basis.statement: 28:38 (Pharaoh: «فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا») together with 51:33 («حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ») strip away every contextual halo — no creation, no divine agency, no life, no punishment-by-creation — leaving ṭīn as ordinary industrial/earthen material fired into bricks and constituting hard stones.

hard_cases.reason: ṭīn constitutes hard projectile stones (حجارة من طين), outside any creation-of-life frame and against any soft/wet-only reading. Confirms the substance is hardenable and agent/purpose-neutral, defeating the creation-nucleus competitor.

evidence_basis.statement: 28:38 (Pharaoh: «فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا») together with 51:33 («حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ») strip away every contextual halo — no creation, no divine agency, no life, no punishment-by-creation — leaving ṭīn as ordinary industrial/earthen material fired into bricks and constituting hard stones.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence resists the bare-substance nucleus, so there is no RESISTANT_SEAM. The two hard cases (28:38, 51:33) are ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY: they refute the richer creation-substance competitor and fix the negative boundary (ṭīn is not inherently creation-material, not soft-only, agent/purpose-neutral). Their statements also appear as strongest_counterexample and in the cluster C note. The MODERATE cap derives not from resistance but from monoformity plus untested distinctiveness from sibling earth-terms.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which ṭīn cannot be read as pre-form moldable earthen material — e.g. a token where ṭīn denotes a finished artifact rather than its source, or where it patterns as fire/water/air rather than earth, or where a derived/verbal form of ط ي ن introduces an operation absent from the frozen nominal.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 12 form-N tokens, with particular stress on the non-creation cluster (28:38, 51:33) and the syntactically deviant accusative (17:61); plus any future attestation of a non-N form of the root.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each token's governing verb and adjacent nouns to confirm ṭīn names the material FROM which something is made (not the product), and confirm all tokens remain form N with no derivational spread.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Separate the collocational contribution of خَلَقَ…مِن (origination) from the noun itself; hold apart the homophonous root ط ي ر (طير) present in 3:49/5:110; treat definiteness/case as syntactic, not semantic.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a token is found, the single moldable-earthen-substance nucleus is falsified and the result must be downgraded to an occurrence-level or unresolved multi-class account.

reopen_conditions: If any verbal, participial, plural, or derived-nominal form of ط ي ن is ever attested, reopen whether ṭīn generalizes to a productive root beyond the frozen nominal — currently all 12 tokens are form N, which is the structural reason the grade is capped below STRONG.

If sibling earth-creation terms (turāb, ṣalṣāl, ḥamaʾ masnūn) can be jointly analyzed against ṭīn, reopen the distinctiveness sub-claim 'ṭīn ≠ generic earth/soil', currently UNRESOLVED because those neighbours do not occur in this packet.

If 28:38 (أوقد…على الطين → صرح) or 51:33 (حجارة من طين) are re-read such that ṭīn is NOT the pre-form material of the ṣarḥ/ḥijārah, reconsider reinstating a creation-material nucleus that is here rejected as merely collocational.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The bare moldable-earthen-substance nucleus holds cleanly across all 12 tokens with zero failing occurrences, and within-packet distinctiveness is established (ṭīn ≠ نار in 7:12/38:76; ṭīn = raw source vs the سلالة/product in 23:12). But a PASSED verdict is withheld: distinctiveness from the sibling earth-creation terms turāb/ṣalṣāl/ḥamaʾ masnūn cannot be tested because they are absent from this packet, and the root is monoform (no derivational family to stress-test), so distinctiveness_ok cannot be affirmed. Marked NOT_RUN in the strong sense: core holds, full adversarial distinctiveness testing is not possible here.
